_meta.measured: views, likes, dates, title length and on-screen layout of the benchmarks (watch page ytInitialData + oar2/maxres1-3 stills); every 'ours_*' value (final/<id>.mp4 scene>0.04 in the 1080x1080 picture box, build/<id>/timeline.json from voice_edge.py)
_meta.estimated: benchmark length, hook end, first cut, shot lengths and syllables per second: the watch pages returned LOGIN_REQUIRED (bot check), so no lengthSeconds, captions or storyboard; values below marked est_* fields come from research-fun.md medians and the frame evidence, not from measurement
_meta.shot_note: ours_shot_mean_s counts any visible change (expression, bubble, big text) at scene>0.04, not only hard cuts

doodle.notes: Title 2 lines on black (white + yellow/green), optional small yellow '(뜻 풀이)' line above for a hard word. Caption inside the picture box, bottom, in a navy/black box, up to 2 lines, quotes in yellow. Topic angle: conflict/etiquette/report ('현재 논란중인 ○○', '○○ 신고하면 벌어지는 일', '읽기만 해도 기빨리는 ○○', 'A vs B' + big numbers). Character 40-60% of the frame, exaggerated emotion. Our pacing is already fast enough; the gap is topic and picture density.

road.notes: Wordless: no narration captions or speech bubbles in any of 12 benchmark stills (audio not checked). 16:9 animation centred in 9:16 with black bars; optional one thin white Korean title line above and an English translation below. Driver face close-ups at 60-70% of picture height cut against 3/4-rear car shots; many cuts are the same cockpit with a new expression or a zoom. Title is a taunt or a villain line, 9-16 chars. Ending = karma/catharsis, not a fine notice. syl_per_s 0 and lines 1 mean: no narration, one title line.

teuk.notes: Title is one line '○○ 특' (3-6 chars measured) about a food/product/person type, not a situation. No top title band: dark solid background, mascot logo top-right, picture box in the middle, white 2-line sentence captions below (no colour keywords). Title card can appear mid-video; start at 0 s with the strongest reaction frame and the first item. Every item gets a different strong picture (reaction face, product/food photo, mascot only for the punch line). Do not read the title aloud as line 1; cut the per-item reaction bubbles to reach ~14 lines.

sseol.notes: One-line declarative title stating an odd fact, 8-11 chars measured, no '~한 이유' ('삼촌이 나보다 두 살 어리다'). Whole video is a light-theme community-app screen: header with app name, post title bar + meta + like button, body = current narration sentence in bold black 1-4 lines centred, square full-colour illustration (~80% width) under it, faint watermark background. Colloquial 반말 narration. Picture and sentence change per sentence. Length can run longer (썰구리 대리운전 썰 56 s measured in research-fun.csv).
